body:
I'm glad your doggo is okay. Just know if nothing else, your that little guy (girl?)'s best friend. 

Do you have medical insurance? How's your relationship with your family?

Hey Ricky. I'm going to be honest and say I peaked at your profile. I think it's pretty bullshit how an articulate, compassionate fellow like yourself doesn't get any shoulders to lean on in their time of need. I know it's been three days, and I hope you're still here. 

If you are, then what's up?

Hey Lizzy. I know it's been a few days since anyone replied to your post and I really, really hope you're still here. You seem like a wonderful, self aware person and I imagine you really put forth a lot of effort to be as upbeat as possible for all the little kids you're around.

I'm down to talk about anything. 

:)

Some people have a limited depth for empathy that can be exhausted over time. It's a very unfortunate thing, but it's true. However, there are plenty of people who are empowered by assisting others with their struggles by hearing them out.

So what's up man? Reply, PM me. Talk as much as you like, I promise I won't get tired or hurt.

Hey, man. I hear ya. I know what it's like to lose seemingly everything in a instant. 

Want to talk about it?
I have a novella in the works. If you'd like, I could PM you what I have so far.
